title: T1683.002 — Generate Content - Audio-Visual Content
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Generate Content - Audio-Visual Content with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated simulation of a deepfake video call fraud attack against a finance employee, with defender evidence at each step

steps.title: Collect public media
steps.caption: The attacker downloads public speeches, interviews, and webinars featuring your executives. Earnings calls are ideal: high quality, long, and free. executive media exposure is attack surface; catalog it.
steps.defender: IdP and SaaS audit logs record token issuance, consent, sign-in location and API access.
